# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/habitat-sim
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/habitat-sim

## File: facebookresearch_habitat-sim/src_python/habitat_sim/agent/agent.py

Prompts

```
['create an Agent instance with a SceneNode and optional AgentConfiguration for sensor specs and action space', 'call Agent.act with an action_id like move_forward or turn_left to execute a movement and check collisions', 'call Agent.get_state or access Agent.state to retrieve the current position, rotation, and sensor states as an AgentState object', 'call Agent.set_state with an AgentState to reposition the agent and optionally reset or infer sensor states', 'call Agent.reconfigure with a new AgentConfiguration to recreate sensors and update the agent action space']
```

Usage

```
{'create_agent': 'create an Agent instance with a SceneNode and optional AgentConfiguration for sensor specs and action space', 'act_agent_action': 'call Agent.act with an action_id like move_forward or turn_left to execute a movement and check collisions', 'get_agent_state': 'call Agent.get_state or access Agent.state to retrieve the current position, rotation, and sensor states as an AgentState object', 'set_agent_state': 'call Agent.set_state with an AgentState to reposition the agent and optionally reset or infer sensor states', 'reconfigure_agent': 'call Agent.reconfigure with a new AgentConfiguration to recreate sensors and update the agent action space'}
```
